drawio_review_note: Aligned jointly with HLE paper arXiv:2501.14249v10, official repository centerforaisafety/hle at 26dca2e253b405105b4c3d8c2f5af06f86f90c66, official dataset cais/hle at revision 5a81a4c7271a2a2a312b9a690f0c2fde837e4c29, Step report arXiv:2602.10604v2, official Step GitHub repository at 21d85a5f6c291f3f138da0bc09979af43345251a, and official Step model at ab446a3de5e171ea341227e24bb1f090e1b771f7. HLEtext is a reporting label for the Step paper's HLE text-only view, not a separate dataset. Full HLE comes from nearly 1,000 experts, more than 70,000 model-stumping attempts, two rounds of expert review, and a 2,500-item public release in which 24% are multiple choice and about 14% require images. The exact selector for HLEtext is not disclosed. Under the official stumping gate, exact-match items must defeat every filtering model, while a multiple-choice item may be solved by at most one model. The HLEtext row count is also not disclosed, so neither selector nor size is inferred; its evaluation code, per-item outputs, and complete run logs are also not released. Section 6.2 states one independent generation per HLE item, pass@1, maximum sequence length 256k, temperature 1.0, and top-p 1.0. Appendix E says the official HLE metric and LLM-judging protocol are used with gpt-oss-120b as judge, but the exact Step runner prompt and parser are not disclosed. Table 5 reports Step 3.5 Flash at 23.1 and PaCoRe with K=[4,4,4,4] at 27.9.
